properties.fullDescription: *Guide £450,000 to £475,000* Beautifully maintained period home full of character and charm Spacious lounge with multi-fuel stove, double-glazed sash windows, and original features Three generous first-floor double-bedrooms plus a charming single/play/music/loft room Private rear garden – Beautifully landscaped and terraced with patios, raised beds, and seating areas. Prime location in Halesworth, just a short walk to the town centre and the train station Attik are delighted to offer this beautifully presented period home set just moments from the centre of Halesworth, a thriving market town with excellent amenities and a strong sense of community. Offering spacious and light-filled accommodation over three floors, the property blends charming original features with thoughtful modern updates. Highlights include a handcrafted kitchen, a cosy lounge with a multi-fuel stove, and four bedrooms including a versatile loft room. Outside, the landscaped rear garden offers multiple seating areas, ornamental planting, and complete privacy - all just a short drive from the stunning Suffolk coast, with Southwold and Walberswick within easy reach. Call the team now to view!The Three-Storey Georgian Home...Tucked away just moments from the charming heart of Halesworth, this beautifully presented period residence offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy town-centre living with a delightful blend of character, comfort, and space. 57 Quay Street is perfectly positioned - just a five-minute stroll into the bustling high street with its independent shops, cafés, and the renowned New Cut Arts Centre - while also placing you within easy reach of the stunning Suffolk Heritage Coast, with Southwold and Walberswick only a short drive away.Step inside to a welcoming hallway stretching the full depth of the house. The lounge is spacious and light-filled, complete with sash windows (double-glazed throughout), exposed floorboards, a multi-fuel stove, and built-in cabinetry flanking the fireplace. At the heart of the home lies a handcrafted kitchen-dining room, with solid wood units, stylish tiling, a movable island, and modern appliances including a five-burner gas hob and integrated double oven. A glazed door opens onto the rear patio, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. To the rear, a clever extension houses a boot room, utility space, studio/workshop, and a well-appointed cloakroom, all bathed in natural light and perfect for modern lifestyles.The first floor offers three generously proportioned bedrooms, including a luxurious master suite with built-in wardrobes and a stylish en-suite shower room. A spacious family bathroom features original floorboards and a repurposed vanity unit for a touch of vintage charm. On the top floor, a cosy loft room makes an ideal single bedroom, playroom, creative studio, or a peaceful retreat.The home is set back slightly with both on-road and private driveway parking, comfortably accommodating multiple vehicles.
